intro: Dominica is a rugged volcanic island covered in rainforest, rivers and hot springs.

chapters.title: Nature Island
text: The Boiling Lake is the world's second-largest hot lake. Morne Trois Pitons National Park is a World Heritage site. Sperm whales live off the coast all year, and Dominica created a sperm whale reserve in 2023.

chapters.title: Rivers
text: Dominica is said to have 365 rivers, one for every day of the year.

places.title: Landscape tour
places.intro: Places that show the variety of Dominica's landscapes. The numbers match the pins on the map.
